messages:
maya: Heads-up — Jonas's birthday + 1-year Redwood anniversary is next Friday. Planning a hybrid surprise! In-office: cake + balloons. Remote: group e-card + gift. Please react to vote: :balloon: in-person cake, :gift: care package, :video_camera: quick surprise call, :memo: sign e-card.
kevin: I can pick up a cake if cake wins. :cake: 
anya: Remote here — happy to run the e-card and handle the e-gift. Link: https://cardservice.example/xyz 
people-ops-bot: NOTE: If ordering food or gifts for the office, submit a requisition in SpendOps by Wednesday so we can expense it. 
izzy: Balloons sound fun but low-key. :balloon: 
kevin: Reactions so far: :balloon: +1, :gift: +1 from me if needed. 
maya: Thanks — flavor suggestion: chocolate with salted caramel. @kevin can you pick up if cake wins? 
kevin: Yep, can do pickup Friday at 11:30am. 
anya: I'll collect contributions and post Venmo link tomorrow. 
people-ops-bot: Current in-office headcount RSVP: 6. 
maya: Final call — please react by EOD tomorrow so I can place orders. :thumbsup:
